dcat_keyword_sm: Ministry of Health and Long Term Care
dct_description_sm:
The current feature layer for Ontario Public Health Units (PHU) reflects the most recent update to the boundaries as per R.R.O. 1990, Reg. 553: Areas Comprising Health Units (available at: R.R.O. 1990, Reg. 553 AREAS COMPRISING HEALTH UNITS | ontario.ca). Effective January 1, 2025, nine public health units merged into four. These voluntary mergers were approved under the Health Protection and Promotion Act.
 

(from 34 to 29 Ontario PHUs) as follows: 

  • Brant County Health Unit and Haldimand-Norfolk Health Unit merged to form the Grand Erie Health Unit (PHU_ID 7652).            
  • Haliburton, Kawartha and Pine Ridge District Health Unit and Peterborough County-City Health Unit merged to form Lakelands Public Health (PHU_ID 7653).            
  • Porcupine Health Unit and Timiskaming Health Unit merged to form the Northeastern Health Unit (PHU_ID 7654).            
    Hastings and Prince Edward Counties Health Unit, Kingston, Frontenac and Lennox and Addington Health Unit, and Leeds, Grenville & Lanark District Health Unit merged to form the Southeast Health Unit (PHU_ID 7655).     

All remaining PHUs, including name and identification number are unchanged. The information is updated as needed.
